description: A CLI script to seed a PostgreSQL database for a career path planning application with realistic or minimal data, supporting JSON-based and fallback datasets. It ensures database schema is synchronized, seeds data for various tables (roles, competencies, adjacency, role-competency mappings, users, plans, goals), and verifies backend API endpoints if available.

methods.name: Optional[List[Dict[str,Any]]] _load_json_list(name: str)
methods.description: Loads JSON data from files in the data directory, returning a list of dictionaries or None if missing or invalid.

methods.name: None _ensure_catalog_tables(db: Session)
methods.description: Creates necessary tables for roles, competencies, adjacency, role competencies, plans, and goals if they do not exist.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int] _upsert_roles(db: Session, items: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Performs idempotent insert/update of role records based on JSON data.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int] _upsert_competencies(db: Session, items: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Performs idempotent insert/update of competency records.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int] _upsert_role_competencies(db: Session, items: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Inserts or updates role-competency mapping records.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int] _upsert_role_adjacency(db: Session, items: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Inserts or updates role adjacency (graph edges) with weights.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int] _upsert_simple_users(db: Session, items: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Upserts simple user data into a demo_users table for testing or demonstration purposes.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int] _upsert_plans(db: Session, items: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Inserts or updates career plans, ensuring no duplicates based on user_id and title.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int] _upsert_goals(db: Session, items: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Inserts or updates goal records associated with plans.

methods.name: Dict[str,List[Dict[str,Any]]] _fallback_dataset()
methods.description: Provides a minimal hardcoded dataset with roles, competencies, adjacency, role mappings, users, plans, and goals for seeding in case JSON files are missing.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int] _attach_goals_by_title(db: Session, goals_by_title: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Resolves plan IDs from plan titles and creates goals linked to those plans.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] seed_full()
methods.description: Main function orchestrating the database seeding process, including schema sync, data loading or fallback, verification, and reporting.

methods.name: None main()
methods.description: Entry point to run the seed script and output the process results.
